text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ahead of the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, 
Daiichi Ruby declares, "My mission still 
lies upon the turf," vowing to continue 
racing going forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of her dream to repay 
everyone, K.S.Miracle renews her resolve 
to claim the title of the fastest. Having 
acknowledged each other, the two vow to 
clash on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A race where neither side will yield an 
inch, competing for the title of fastest 
sprinter— The GⅠ Takamatsunomiya Kinen 
begins...!
